Farhan Pandey | farhan.pandey17@example.com | +91 9968925621
Secunderabad

Professional Summary
Experienced backend developer focused on building scalable microservices and high-throughput data pipelines. Strong proficiency in Go, gRPC-based APIs, containerized deployments, and event-driven architectures. Proven track record delivering production services with observability, resilience, and automated CI/CD workflows. Notice period: 90 days.

Technical Skills
Go, gRPC, Microservices, Docker, Apache Kafka, Git

Work Experience

Senior Go Developer, Infosys (Dec 2025 - Present)
- Implemented gRPC service interfaces in Go for a payment reconciliation microservice, reducing end-to-end latency by 35% while maintaining backward-compatible proto contracts. Used Docker for containerized deployments.
- Designed and developed service-level health and metrics endpoints integrated with existing observability stack; enabled faster incident detection and decreased mean time to recovery.
- Built CI/CD pipelines that containerize Go binaries with Docker and automate rollouts to staging, enabling safe canary deployments and streamlined release cadence.

Backend Engineer, Vertex Analytics (Sep 2020 - Nov 2025)
- Developed Go-based microservices that consumed and produced events via Apache Kafka to process analytics streams; optimized consumer group throughput to handle a 4x increase in event volume.
- Implemented gRPC gateway services to expose low-latency APIs for downstream analytics clients and standardized proto schemas for cross-team integration.
- Containerized services using Docker and authored deployment manifests to simplify local development and production rollout; integrated Git-based workflows for code reviews and automated builds.

Education
MCA, Symbiosis
